The '''Regional Fork-Pitcher's Local''' was an agricultural union based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Saheelindeel]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the group was the heavy favorite to win the trophy for the best thematic float during the the high festival of ''[[Fertility of the Soil, Challenge of the Sky]]''.
